title: The Landfall of Devil's Throat
author: Jude Nystrom
blurb: Ines Coldharbour, a desert ranger tracking a thief across nothing, has spent twelve years measuring life in miles rather than years. But when a dying prospector trades a map for a promise, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must beat the salvage fleet to the wreck by six tides, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
